subjects.title: Producing Handwritten / Printed or Digital Magazines

units.title: Ideation, Editorial Planning and Content Writing
units.topics: Ideation about title of magazine, theme-based content planning, production schedule, writing poems, stories and articles, sharing responsibilities: Editor, writers, sub-editors, proof-readers, designers.

units.title: Magazine Design, Production and Publishing
units.topics: Handwritten, typed-designed-printed and digital magazine formats, software tools (Word, Photoshop, Canva, InDesign), visiting nearby Printing Press, Content Management System for digital upload, publishing and evaluation.

notes: Co-Curricular Course can be selected in any one semester (II / III / IV); listed under semester 2.
